purpose: Run physical choice comparisons automatically after repaired training advances; keep every completion and failure receipt.

classes.frequent: Runs every every_steps training updates and may pause training for its own saved window.
classes.triggered: Runs when one of its declared triggers fires, joining the next saved window, or at its longest interval (every_steps). It pauses training by itself only at that interval, or once ride_along_steps have passed since a trigger fired without a window. Triggers: a committed change to its declared code since its last round (code), a change of the production run's flags (flags), a listed task's result crossing its declared line, its own included (lines), a live gauge moving more than its tolerance since its last round (gauges).
classes.decided: 2026-09-25, the operator's decision of 9:09 AM PDT (docs/gain_of_function_v3/WORKLOG.md, 'Operator decisions'): split the tests into cheap ones that run often and heavy ones that run less often or on a trigger. Classes, cadences, tolerances and the arithmetic of the expected training break, from the scheduler's receipts: docs/gain_of_function_v4/agents/scheduler_classes_2026-09-25.md.

tasks.held: 2026-09-25 12:56 AM PDT: held (first_step 999999999, planned 380500; the next round was due at step 402,100). The independent review of the new three-layer self-touch test found that its prediction and selection scores can pass for the wrong reason: the selection score does not use the planner's own effort term and ignores how the planner picks finger poses; it counts a pair as 'wellness prefers the touch' on differences far smaller than the evaluator can tell apart; neither score has a matched control, so 50 of 100 is not the chance line; and one body with many pairs can carry the verdict. The round runs again once the fixes are made and reviewed.
